Two hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:

Dual Socket P (LGA 3647) support
 2nd Gen. Intel® Xeon® Scalable
 processors (Cascade Lake/Skylake)

2 PCI-E 3.0 x8 (FH/HL) or 1 PCI-E 3.0
 x8 (FH/HL) + 1 PCI-E 3.0 x4 (FH/HL)
 + 1 PCI-E 3.0 x 4 (LP) (8/8/0 or 8/4/4)

Up to 1200W Redundant Power Supplies
 Titanium Level (96%)
